reviews.t: A must have for any self manicurist!
reviews.x: I absolutely love these!  I do all my own polish, including gel manicures which are impossible to fix after they set. I tried these polish stencils in a whim and am glad I did! They come in a ton of different sizes, including multiples of common sizes. They stay on nicely and snug so no polish seeps out of the sides. I haven't tried them with a French manicure yet but they do come with sticker guides for those as well! The packaging also has a tongue guide so you can write down the number that f

These work really well for making sure the polish does not get on your hands or skin for anyone who is new or unfamiliar with applying nail polish. The only problem is that putting them hurts a bit because if they are not tightly put on your fingers, they will fall off. Overall, they are worth the price but you'll need to endure just a bit of pain.

This are a girls best friend. I love doing my nails all the time from ombre to stamping. I love that these are reusable and so flexible. I do have little bit of bigger fingers than most. But I just used what every size fit the finger and it worked out well. I usually do one finger at a time anyways. So it didn't seem like a big deal to me. They covered everything that needed and saved me a lot of clean up time. Will differently recommend them to any girls that loves to do their nails.  I receive

reviews.t: Good for Side of Nail Protection
reviews.x: These are great for protecting the sides of the nail from getting polish on your finger....just wish there was a band or something across the cuticle area to also protect that or I would have given 5 stars.

I expected this to be a throwaway purchase, but it actually works really well. Usually, it looks like a five-year-old painted my right hand, but these guides provided enough ... guidance ... that I only had to do touchups. I'm using it with gel polish, so I put them on for non-clear coats, then take them off and do touchups BEFORE curing the layer. Much to my amazement, they are working perfectly. Do expect, however that you'll need to do some touch up work with an orange stick before curing/dry

reviews.t: Didn't work as expected but GREAT Customer Service!
reviews.x: Pro: Awesome Customer service! I would be happy to purchase from this seller again!  Con: These forms are difficult to stay on my fingers and so they paint gets stuck on them and pulls off my finish before I can get the polish to dry. Good idea, poor design.

The idea of this product is great but they did not fit around my nails at all. They come with quite a few different sizes but none of them surrounded my nail correctly. I returned them. After getting the product, if I were to purchase again, I would pay no more than $5 max for them. They are made from pretty thin, cheap plastic.

reviews.t: Doesn't fit any of my fingers.
reviews.x: None of the sizes fit my fingers properly. I tried every size on every finger, but I can't get any of them to fit. I might as well have saved my money and not bought this product, as my fingers aren't going to be protected while painting them.
I'm 70 years old, and thought these might help, they didn't.  Made more mess then usual.  lol

reviews.t: Works well on people with tiny hands and little nails
reviews.x: Maybe I have fat fingers. I don't know. These work well on kids and people with dainty nails. My hooves are just too big or wide or something. I have used them on my daughter to paint her nails and they're great for her. These things squeeze my fingers to the point of pain.  My advice? If you have kids, YES, it will keep your mess cleanup to a minimum.  For adults, use only if you have those kinds of hands that are dainty.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stencils work well for protecting the skin around the nail and keeping polish off fingers, especially for gel manicures and beginners.
A common complaint is that the stencils do not fit many users' fingers properly, with some unable to find any size that fits.
Several reviewers report the stencils fall off or pop off easily, causing polish to smear or pull off the finish.
Some users wish the material were softer or more rubbery rather than hard plastic, and that the shapes were straighter or better curved.
A few reviewers praise the product's reusability, flexibility, and the seller's customer service.
